painting-mss.title: reproduktion, tavla, painting, Ru-ton-ye-wee-ma
painting-mss.reason: This is a reproduction of George Catlin's 1830s portrait of Ru-ton-ye-wee-ma, "The Strutting Pigeon," an Iowa woman with child, showing traditional dress, hairstyle, and body paint of the Iowa people — a documentary depiction by an outside artist but of genuine Iowa subject and attire.
